notes.title: 1.0 Released
notes.content:
Thank you for all the great feedback from early access! 

We are proud of our 1.0 release, enjoy!

1.0 Release Notes

- Bonefeather fireball invoke SFX added, giving players more time to react.
- Devourer attack animations added.
- Devourer fires exploding plasma balls at castle.
- Demon Jump Attack added with new audio.
- Spider bug SFX added and attack speed slowdown.
- Numerous physics based castle props added.
- Castle keep added that counts as a defendable tower.
- Wave balancing, more shots at player.
- Leaderboard !
- Terrain polish, new trees for better performance.
- Lightning FX
- Flying bugs audio
- Improved Dragon physics and audio
- Asteroid splitting bug fixed.
- Asteroids no longer destroy each other.
- Throne SFX added
